profile.headline: Frontend & WordPress Developer | Javascript | HTML | CSS | 8+ years experience | Remote
profile.geoLocationName: Buenos Aires, Buenos Aires Province, Argentina
profile.summary:
im a Frontend Developer with 8+ years of experience building responsive, performant, and user-friendly websites and web applications. 

I have worked on e-commerce platforms, landing pages, and custom CMS-based websites, often collaborating closely with designers and backend developers. I enjoy creating reusable components, optimizing web performance, and ensuring pixel-perfect UX/UI.

Currently, I am focused on remote opportunities where I can contribute to  growing professionally.

Tech stack: JavaScript, HTML, CSS, WordPress, Git, SEO basics, Figma , Agile/Scrum.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description: At Minimalart, I build custom websites using WordPress, React, HTML/CSS, and TypeScript. I work on e-commerce platforms, landing pages, and corporate websites, collaborating with the backend team to implement new features and optimize user experience. I use technologies like PHP, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Git daily, focusing on responsive design, performance, and clean code.
positions.insights: Skills: Comunicación · Desarrollo front end · Plugins · css · HTML5 · Principios de diseño · Elementor · PHP · JavaScript · GitHub · Git

positions.title: Frontend Developer - Freelance
positions.description: As a freelance developer, I built custom websites and features using HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP, often working with Elementor, custom WordPress plugins, and GitHub for version control. I focused on front-end development, design principles, and occasionally worked with React for interactive components. Projects ranged from landing pages to full website builds.
positions.insights: Skills: MySQL · Comunicación · Desarrollo front end · Plugins · HTML5 · Principios de diseño · Elementor · PHP · JavaScript · GitHub · Git

positions.title: WordPress developer
positions.description: I built custom websites using WordPress, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, focusing on responsive design and performance. I worked with tools like Elementor, WooCommerce, Advanced Custom Fields (ACF), and custom themes/plugins development. My role included creating landing pages, blogs, and corporate sites, collaborating closely with designers and ensuring clean, scalable code.
positions.insights: Skills: Comunicación · Plugins · HTML5 · Principios de diseño · Elementor · GitHub

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: I collaborated with a development team on a business directory platform for SMEs, using WordPress, PHP, and custom CMS tools. My role included managing content updates, client onboarding, and implementing website enhancements. I contributed to both site maintenance and feature development, ensuring functionality and scalability.
positions.insights: Skills: Comunicación · HTML5 · Principios de diseño · GitHub

positions.title: Social Media Manager and Web Designer
positions.description: I managed social media content and designed marketing assets while starting my journey in web development. I created simple websites and landing pages using HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript. This role helped me build a strong foundation in visual design, user experience, and front-end development.
positions.insights: Skills: Comunicación · HTML5 · Principios de diseño
